projectContext.description: voiceover-matcher-subtitle: AI-powered pipeline for matching voiceover to stock footage

userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for quality focus area
userStories.notes: Seed story completed. Generated 11 stories (US-53-002 through US-53-012) covering: scoring config extraction, confidence audit trail, embedding validation, match diversity metrics, network failure pattern accuracy, cookie propagation for Python API, stall detection config, global escalation state, iterative match serialization robustness, scoring threshold documentation, and pool normalization transparency. Stories derived from user interview (6 download_segments issues) plus codebase analysis of src/matching/ hardcoded thresholds and silent failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Read scripts/ralph/config/ralph-config.json to understand the 'quality' focus area
Read scripts/ralph/session/prompt.md for project context and architecture notes
Read scripts/ralph/state/queue.json for interview details (story outline, architecture decisions, key files)
Read CLAUDE.md for project conventions and known issues
Analyze the codebase to find 8-12 specific improvements for 'quality'
Add stories US-53-002 through US-53-012 to scripts/ralph/state/prd.json (MUST use sprint-prefixed IDs)
Each story MUST have 4-6 testable acceptance criteria
Each story MUST have a 'notes' field with: (1) tier classification, (2) exact source file paths, (3) line number ranges if removing/moving code

Mark this story (US-53-001) as passes: true when done

userStories.title: Extract hardcoded scoring thresholds into MatchingScoringConfig dataclass
userStories.notes: Completed. Created MatchingScoringConfig dataclass with 20 configurable fields covering: confidence floor/warning, entity match boosts, keyword overlap thresholds, transcript quality thresholds, multimodal default weights, semantic coherence thresholds, and pool normalization constants. Wired into MatchingConfig with __post_init__ for nested dict-to-dataclass conversion. Updated scoring.py functions (apply_entity_match_boost, calculate_transcript_quality, compute_multimodal_score, calculate_keyword_overlap_score, compute_semantic_coherence, normalize_confidence_by_pool, MatchScoring class) to read from config with getattr() fallback. Added scoring section to config.yaml with commented defaults. All 1247 tests pass (1 pre-existing failure unrelated).
acceptanceCriteria: Create MatchingScoringConfig dataclass in src/config/sections/matching.py with fields for: confidence_floor (default 0.05), low_confidence_warning_threshold (default 0.15), entity_match_boosts (dict with 1/2/3+ keys), keyword_overlap_thresholds (dict), transcript_quality_thresholds (high/medium), multimodal_default_weights (embedding/keyword/entity/visual)
Wire MatchingScoringConfig into the existing MatchingConfig dataclass with __post_init__ for nested dict-to-dataclass conversion
Update scoring.py to read thresholds from config instead of module-level constants, with getattr() fallback to current defaults
Add scoring section to config.yaml with commented defaults matching current hardcoded values
Verify python -m py_compile src/config/sections/matching.py and python -m py_compile src/matching/scoring.py both succeed

userStories.title: Add confidence score audit trail to MatchResult
userStories.notes: Tier: T2 (medium, touches scoring pipeline). Source files: src/matching/scoring.py (apply_all_adjustments around line 1677-1712 where penalties/boosts applied silently), src/matching/tiered_matcher.py (match_segment method where final score assembled), src/utils.py (MatchResult dataclass). Currently when a match confidence is 0.52, there's no way to tell which penalties/boosts contributed. The scoring chain applies timing penalty, topic penalty, broll boost, etc. but doesn't record what fired.
acceptanceCriteria: Add confidence_breakdown field (list of dicts with keys: component, adjustment, reason) to MatchResult or as a separate dataclass
Modify apply_all_adjustments() in scoring.py to populate the breakdown list with each penalty/boost applied (name, delta, reason string)
Log confidence breakdown at DEBUG level when match finalized: e.g. 'confidence: 0.85 -> 0.75 (topic_penalty: -0.10, timing_penalty: -0.00)'
Ensure breakdown is serializable (dict/list) so it survives checkpoint JSON serialization
Add test that verifies breakdown list is populated when adjustments are applied

userStories.title: Add embedding validation before matching starts
userStories.notes: Tier: T1 (small, validation logic). Source files: src/matching/main.py (line 195 where embedding_search called without pre-validation), src/embeddings.py (lines 680, 727, 796 where embeddings computed/cached). When embedding API fails midway, some segments get None embeddings. Code continues with degraded quality but no clear indication. FAISS queries return garbage matches if embeddings have inconsistent dimensions or aren't normalized.
acceptanceCriteria: Add validate_embedding_integrity() function in src/embeddings.py that checks: no None values, consistent dimensions across all embeddings, norms approximately 1.0 (unit vectors for cosine similarity)
Call validate_embedding_integrity() in src/matching/main.py before embedding search, log WARNING with count of invalid embeddings and skip those segments
Log the embedding cache hit/miss rate during the matching stage at INFO level
Handle the case where all embeddings are None gracefully (skip embedding-based matching, fall back to keyword-only)
Add test for validate_embedding_integrity() with mixed valid/None/wrong-dimension inputs

userStories.title: Add match diversity metrics and source concentration warnings
userStories.notes: Tier: T2 (medium, metrics + logging). Source files: src/matching/main.py (lines 420-443 where only V1 source concentration tracked), src/stages/match.py (stage output where metrics could be reported). Currently only V1 track source concentration is analyzed. No detection of temporal clustering, no V2-V6 diversity metrics, no warning when variety constraints get relaxed (line 232 logs debug only).
acceptanceCriteria: Compute source concentration ratio for each track (V1-V8) as percentage of clips from the most-used source video
Log WARNING when any track has >60% of clips from a single source video
Detect and log temporal clustering: when 3+ consecutive segments use the same source video
Include diversity metrics in the stage completion log: unique sources per track, max concentration ratio, temporal cluster count
Add test that verifies diversity warnings fire when mock matches have >60% concentration from one source

userStories.title: Harden _is_network_failure pattern matching for Python API error format
userStories.notes: Tier: T1 (small, regex + tests). Source files: src/downloader/error_classification.py (where _is_network_failure patterns live after US-52-006 extraction), src/stages/download_segments.py (lines 536-557 where network failure abort logic uses these patterns). The Python API exception message format may differ from subprocess stderr. Specific patterns needed: 'Errno 11001' (DNS), ffmpeg exit code 0xFFFFFEC6 (-314 signed) from network loss, and 'Failed to resolve' patterns. Bot-detection errors (403, 'Sign in') currently reset the network counter instead of contributing to abort threshold.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Python API error format patterns to _is_network_failure() in error_classification.py: 'Errno 11001', 'Failed to resolve', 'getaddrinfo failed', ffmpeg exit code patterns (4294967158, -314)
Add test cases for each new pattern in test_error_classification.py verifying they return True for network failures
Verify that existing subprocess-format patterns still match correctly (no regression)
Add test case for the ffmpeg unsigned exit code 4294967158 and its signed equivalent -314
Ensure the module compiles cleanly: python -m py_compile src/downloader/error_classification.py

userStories.title: Add cookie propagation to download_segments Python API calls
userStories.notes: Tier: T2 (medium, config + integration). Source files: src/stages/download_segments.py (the _build_ydl_opts method where ydl_opts assembled — US-52-005 builder), src/config/sections/download.py (download config dataclass), config.yaml (download section). The Python API in download_segments.py doesn't read ~/.config/yt-dlp/config, so it gets zero cookies. CLI works because it reads --cookies-from-browser firefox from that config. Need to inject cookiesfrombrowser into ydl_opts from download config. Check if _build_ydl_opts already handles this from the US-52-005 builder work.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify _build_ydl_opts() in download_segments.py injects cookiesfrombrowser or cookiefile into ydl_opts from download config
If not present, add cookies_from_browser field to download config dataclass (default: ['firefox']) and inject ydl_opts['cookiesfrombrowser'] = config value
Add cookiefile fallback: if cookiesfrombrowser fails (no browser installed), fall back to a configured cookie file path
Add config.yaml entry under download section: cookies_from_browser with commented default ['firefox']
Add test that verifies _build_ydl_opts() output dict contains 'cookiesfrombrowser' key when config has cookies_from_browser set

userStories.title: Make segment_stall_timeout and bot-detection thresholds configurable in config.yaml
userStories.notes: Tier: T1 (small, config additions). Source files: src/stages/download_segments.py (lines 684-691 where _stall_timeout read with hardcoded fallback 120, lines 586-597 where bot thresholds read), src/config/sections/download.py (download config dataclass), src/downloader/error_classification.py (module-level NETWORK_FAILURE_THRESHOLD=3, BOT_DETECTION_ABORT_THRESHOLD). Add these fields to config.yaml download section with comments explaining each threshold's purpose
Verify the fields are read correctly in download_segments.py _download_segments() method via getattr with matching defaults
Add network_failure_threshold (default: 3) to config if it's only a module-level constant
Verify python -m py_compile src/config/sections/download.py succeeds

userStories.title: Log scoring component breakdown for low-confidence matches
userStories.notes: Tier: T1 (small, logging additions). Source files: src/matching/scoring.py (lines 1044-1164 multimodal scoring where component scores silently clamped, lines 1110-1119 NaN/Inf handling, lines 587-616 low-confidence pattern analysis). When multimodal components fail (keyword_overlap=0, entity_match=0), the score drops to embedding-only without visibility. NaN→0.0 and Inf→1.0 conversions happen silently. The low-confidence pattern analyzer detects abstract content but doesn't correlate to which scoring penalties fired.
acceptanceCriteria: Log at WARNING level when any multimodal component score is NaN or Inf (before clamping), including which component and the raw value
Log at DEBUG level the component breakdown for every scored match: embedding_similarity, keyword_overlap, entity_match, visual_similarity with their weights
Log at INFO level when multimodal scoring falls back to embedding-only mode (all non-embedding components are 0)
Add a summary log at end of matching stage: count of matches where multimodal was fully active vs embedding-only fallback
Add test that verifies NaN component triggers WARNING log using caplog fixture

userStories.title: Improve iterative match serialization robustness for checkpoint restore
userStories.notes: Tier: T1 (small, defensive coding). Source files: src/stages/iterative_match.py (lines 440-469 serialization, lines 458-468 drill-into fallback added by previous sprint). The else branch now has a drill-into fallback for MatchResult (US-52 work), but there's no validation that the restored data is actually usable. Match.from_dict() can still reject entries silently. This story adds validation logging so failed restores are visible.
acceptanceCriteria: Add validation logging when serialized match has empty video_file after all fallback attempts — log WARNING with match index and available attributes
Add a summary log after serialization: 'Serialized N matches, M had empty video_file (skipped)' at INFO level
Add defensive None check on primary_match.video_segment.source_file (could be None even when video_segment exists)
Verify that checkpoint restore round-trip works: serialize matches, write to JSON, read back, deserialize — count should match
Add test with mock MatchResult where primary_match.video_segment.source_file is None to verify the fallback logs correctly

userStories.title: Add confidence variance validation to prevent false certainty in adaptive threshold
userStories.notes: Tier: T1 (small, validation + logging). Source files: src/matching/tiered_matcher.py (lines 243-254 where variance computed on top-5 scores only), src/matching/scoring.py (lines 62-72 where adaptive threshold reduced for low variance). If top-5 scores are nearly identical (e.g., all 0.85), variance=0 but code treats it as 'clear winner'. Adaptive threshold reduces for low variance (silently), potentially skipping LLM reranking for uncertain matches.
acceptanceCriteria: Add minimum variance floor (0.02) — when computed variance < floor, treat as 'uncertain' rather than 'clear winner' for adaptive threshold decisions
Compute variance on top-10 candidates instead of top-5 when pool size >= 10, falling back to top-5 for smaller pools
Log at DEBUG level the variance computation: candidate count, computed variance, whether adaptive threshold adjustment applied
Add NaN/Inf guard on variance computation (statistics.stdev can raise on single-element lists)
Add test that verifies variance floor prevents adaptive threshold reduction when top-5 scores are within 0.01 of each other

userStories.title: Add pool normalization transparency logging
userStories.notes: Tier: T1 (small, logging only). Source files: src/matching/scoring.py (lines 1803-1908 pool normalization, lines 1868-1880 small pool boost / large pool penalty logic). Pool normalization adjusts scores based on candidate pool size but the adjustment is opaque — reason strings show the factor but not why. Constants REFERENCE_SIZE=50, MIN_FACTOR=0.8, MAX_FACTOR=1.2, SMALL=10, LARGE=100 are hardcoded at lines 1479-1484.
acceptanceCriteria: Log at DEBUG level for each segment: pool_size, top margin (score difference between 1st and 2nd candidate), normalization factor applied, and reason category (small_pool_boost / large_pool_penalty / no_adjustment)
Log at INFO level a summary after all segments normalized: count of segments receiving boost vs penalty vs no adjustment

Expose pool normalization constants (REFERENCE_SIZE, MIN_FACTOR, MAX_FACTOR, SMALL_POOL_THRESHOLD, LARGE_POOL_THRESHOLD) to the MatchingScoringConfig from US-53-002 if that story is complete, otherwise use getattr fallback with current defaults
Add test verifying pool normalization logs appear for a small pool (size=5) and a large pool (size=200) using caplog fixture
